builds.name: Archery range
builds.about: Three targets on hay bales, and a gravel line to shoot from.

layers.name: Shooting line
layers.tip: On flat grass, swap the front row for gravel. That is where you stand.

layers.name: Hay bales
layers.tip: Three hay bales along the back, with a gap between each. A barrel on the gravel holds your arrows. Fence posts at the ends of the line hold torches.

layers.name: Targets
layers.tip: A target on each hay bale, and a torch on each post. Make a target from a hay bale and redstone.

builds.name: Archway
builds.about: A stone arch to walk through, for the way into a garden or a town.

layers.name: Pillars
layers.tip: Two pillars, each two blocks by two, with a gap of three between them.

layers.name: Pillars
layers.tip: Keep going up.

layers.name: Pillars
layers.tip: One more on each pillar.

layers.name: Round the corners
layers.tip: A slab in the top half of each inside corner makes the arch round.

layers.name: Top
layers.tip: Join the two pillars with a row of stone bricks.

layers.name: Lights
layers.tip: A torch on each end.

builds.name: Bee house
builds.about: Two beehives under a little roof, with flowers all around for the bees.

layers.name: Path
layers.tip: Find a flat grassy spot. Dig a short path at the front and fill it with gravel.

layers.name: Posts and flowers
layers.tip: Put up two log posts, three blocks apart. Plant flowers all around: bees need flowers to make honey.

layers.name: Beehives
layers.tip: A log on each post, then a beehive, a plank and a beehive between them. Turn the beehives to face the front.

layers.name: Roof
layers.tip: Cover the row with birch slabs, and one more row behind it. Hold a flower and bees will follow you.

builds.name: Birthday cake
builds.about: A giant cake with pink and white layers, a cherry on top and four candles.

layers.name: Bottom layer
layers.tip: A square of pink wool, 5 by 5.

layers.name: Cream
layers.tip: A square of white wool for the cream.

layers.name: Top layer
layers.tip: Pink wool again.

layers.name: Icing
layers.tip: White wool on top for the icing.

layers.name: Cherry and candles
layers.tip: A red wool cherry in the middle, and four torches around it for candles.

builds.name: Bus stop
builds.about: A little shelter with a glass back, a bench and a yellow sign.

layers.name: Pavement
layers.tip: Lay smooth stone, 7 blocks long and 3 deep.

layers.name: Walls and bench
layers.tip: Stone brick posts at the back corners with glass between them, and glass on both sides. Three oak stairs, tall side at the back, make the bench. Start the sign post with a fence.

layers.name: More walls
layers.tip: The same walls again, and one more fence on the post.

layers.name: Roof and sign
layers.tip: Cover the shelter with glass, so it stays light inside. A yellow wool block on the post is the bus sign.

builds.name: Campfire with seats
builds.about: A campfire in a ring of stones, with benches all around to sit and tell stories.

layers.name: Fire and benches
layers.tip: The campfire goes in the middle, with cobblestone slabs around it. Stairs make the benches: their tall back faces away from the fire.

layers.name: Lights
layers.tip: A torch on each corner post.

builds.name: Cat house
builds.about: A little wooden house with a bed inside for your cat.

layers.name: Floor
layers.tip: Lay the floor first, with a log in each corner.

layers.name: Walls and door
layers.tip: Leave the middle of the front open: that's the door. The orange wool is the cat's bed.

layers.name: Windows
layers.tip: Glass in the middle of each side makes two windows.

layers.name: Roof
layers.tip: Cover the whole top with spruce planks.

layers.name: Roof top
layers.tip: A smaller square in the middle finishes the roof.

builds.name: Chicken coop
builds.about: A hut with hay nests and a fenced yard, so your chickens stay safe.

layers.name: Hut and yard
layers.tip: Build the hut walls at the back, with hay bales inside for nests. Then put a fence around the yard, with a gate in the front.

layers.name: Walls
layers.tip: One more row on the hut walls, with glass on the sides for windows.

layers.name: Roof
layers.tip: Cover the hut with spruce slabs.

builds.name: Dog house
builds.about: A cozy house with a pointy roof and a soft bed for your dog.

layers.name: Floor
layers.tip: Make a square of oak planks, 5 by 5.

layers.name: Walls and door
layers.tip: Build the walls around the edge. Leave the middle of the front open for the door. The red carpet is the bed.

layers.name: Top of the walls
layers.tip: One more row all the way around. This time the front is closed.

layers.name: Roof sides
layers.tip: Put stairs along the left and right edges, with their tall side towards the middle. Fill the front and back with planks.

layers.name: More roof
layers.tip: One step in: two more lines of stairs, and one plank at the front and the back.

layers.name: Roof top
layers.tip: A line of spruce planks down the middle closes the roof.

builds.name: Flower garden
builds.about: A garden full of flowers, with a gravel path, a fence and a little bush.

layers.name: Path
layers.tip: Find a flat grassy spot. Dig out the path and fill it with gravel: a loop in the middle and a line to the front.

layers.name: Fence and flowers
layers.tip: Put a fence all around with a gate at the front. Plant flowers on the grass, and a block of leaves in the middle for a bush.

layers.name: Lights
layers.tip: A torch on each corner post.

builds.name: Gift box
builds.about: A giant present wrapped in red, with a yellow ribbon and a bow on top.

layers.name: Bottom
layers.tip: Red wool, with a yellow cross through the middle for the ribbon.

layers.name: Sides
layers.tip: Red wool around the edge, with yellow in the middle of each side. Leave the inside empty.

layers.name: More sides
layers.tip: The same again.

layers.name: Top
layers.tip: Cover it like the bottom: red with a yellow cross.

layers.name: Bow
layers.tip: Five yellow wool on top in an X shape.

builds.name: Heart statue
builds.about: A big red heart standing on a stone base, with a pink shine.

layers.name: Base
layers.tip: A square of stone bricks, 3 by 3.

layers.name: Point
layers.tip: The point of the heart: one red wool in the middle of the base.

layers.name: Row 2
layers.tip: Three red wool, in a line from left to right.

layers.name: Row 3
layers.tip: Five red wool.

layers.name: Row 4
layers.tip: Seven red wool: the widest row.

layers.name: Row 5
layers.tip: Seven again, with pink wool second from the left for the shine.

layers.name: Top
layers.tip: Two bumps of two wool each, with a gap in the middle.

builds.name: Holiday tree
builds.about: A pointy spruce tree with colourful baubles, a yellow star and presents underneath.

layers.name: Trunk and presents
layers.tip: A spruce log in the middle. Wool blocks around it are the presents.

layers.name: Bottom branches
layers.tip: A log on the trunk, and spruce leaves around it in a big diamond. Some red and blue wool are baubles. Collect leaves with shears.

layers.name: Middle branches
layers.tip: A smaller diamond of leaves around the trunk.

layers.name: More branches
layers.tip: The same size again, with baubles in new places.

layers.name: Top branches
layers.tip: A small plus of leaves around the trunk.

layers.name: Treetop
layers.tip: One more small plus.

layers.name: Point
layers.tip: A single leaf on top of the trunk.

layers.name: Star
layers.tip: Yellow wool on the very top is the star.

builds.name: Igloo
builds.about: A round snow house with a rug and a light inside.

layers.name: Round wall
layers.tip: Make a circle of snow blocks with a gap at the front for the door. Put a rug and a torch inside.

layers.name: Round wall
layers.tip: The same circle again.

layers.name: Start the dome
layers.tip: This row leans in: the corners fill in, and the door gets a top.

layers.name: Close the dome
layers.tip: Fill in the top, one step smaller.

layers.name: Top
layers.tip: A small square on top rounds it off.

builds.name: Market stall
builds.about: A little shop with a striped roof, a counter and things to sell.

layers.name: Counter and posts
layers.tip: Fence posts in the four corners. Barrels at the back, and a counter of planks at the front.

layers.name: Things to sell
layers.tip: Put a pumpkin, a cloth and a melon on the counter.

layers.name: Posts
layers.tip: One more fence on each corner post.

layers.name: Striped roof
layers.tip: Red and white wool in stripes, from the back to the front.

builds.name: Mini golf hole
builds.about: A green course with a wooden edge, a bump in the middle, a hole and a flag.

layers.name: Green
layers.tip: On flat grass, swap the middle for lime wool, 5 by 5. Leave one square near the back empty: that is the hole.

layers.name: Edge, bump and flag
layers.tip: Oak slabs all around the edge. One more slab in the middle is a bump. Start the flag pole with a fence next to the hole, and put white carpet at the front to start from.

layers.name: Flag pole
layers.tip: One more fence on the pole.

layers.name: Flag
layers.tip: A last fence, with red wool beside it for the flag. Can you throw a snowball into the hole?

builds.name: Park bench
builds.about: A bench by a gravel path, with bushes, flowers and a lamp post.

layers.name: Path
layers.tip: On flat grass, dig a line one row in front of the bench and fill it with gravel.

layers.name: Bench and bushes
layers.tip: Four oak stairs in a row, with their tall side at the back, make the bench. A block of leaves on each end is a bush. Start the lamp post with a fence, and plant flowers.

layers.name: Lamp post
layers.tip: One more fence on the post.

layers.name: Lantern
layers.tip: A lantern on top. Make one from iron nuggets around a torch.

builds.name: Picnic spot
builds.about: A checked picnic blanket with a basket, under a little oak tree.

layers.name: Path
layers.tip: Find a flat grassy spot. Dig a short path at the front right and fill it with gravel.

layers.name: Blanket and tree
layers.tip: Lay red and white carpet in a checked square for the blanket. A barrel beside it is the basket. Start the tree with a log, and plant some flowers.

layers.name: Tree trunk
layers.tip: One more log on the tree.

layers.name: Leaves
layers.tip: A last log, with leaves all around it. Collect leaves with shears.

layers.name: More leaves
layers.tip: A square of leaves on top.

layers.name: Treetop
layers.tip: Five leaves in a plus shape finish the tree. Leaves you place yourself never fall.

builds.name: Pumpkin patch
builds.about: A fenced patch full of pumpkins, with a stack of hay and glowing jack o'lanterns.

layers.name: Path
layers.tip: On flat grass, dig a short path from the front and fill it with gravel.

layers.name: Fence, hay and pumpkins
layers.tip: Put a fence all around with a gate at the front. Stack hay bales in the back corner and put pumpkins all over the grass. Use shears on one to carve a face.

layers.name: Jack o'lanterns
layers.tip: Put a torch with a carved pumpkin to make a jack o'lantern. Put two on the hay, and a torch on each front corner.

builds.name: Rabbit hutch
builds.about: A low wooden hutch with hay beds, and a fenced yard with flowers.

layers.name: Floor
layers.tip: Find a flat grassy spot. Swap the grass at the back for spruce planks: that's the hutch floor. The rest stays grass for the yard.

layers.name: Hutch and fence
layers.tip: Build the hutch walls on the floor, with a gap in the middle of the front so rabbits can hop in. Fences beside the gap are windows, and hay bales inside are beds. Fence the yard, with a gate at the front, and plant dandelions: rabbits love them.

layers.name: Roof and lights
layers.tip: Cover the hutch with spruce slabs, and put a torch on each corner post of the yard.

builds.name: Rock garden
builds.about: Mossy rocks, ferns and flowers around a little pond, with a gravel path.

layers.name: Pond and path
layers.tip: On flat grass, dig a square 2 by 2 at the back right and fill it with water. Dig a path from the front to the middle and fill it with gravel.

layers.name: Rocks and plants
layers.tip: Build two rocks from cobblestone, mossy cobblestone, stone and andesite. Plant ferns and flowers around them. Get ferns with shears.

layers.name: Rock tops
layers.tip: A few more stones on top make the rocks taller.

builds.name: Scarecrow
builds.about: A friendly scarecrow with a pumpkin head, watching over a little wheat field.

layers.name: Water and farmland
layers.tip: On flat grass, dig one block in the middle and fill it with water. Hoe the three rows around it into farmland. Leave the back and front rows as grass.

layers.name: Wheat, pumpkins and a post
layers.tip: Plant wheat seeds on the farmland. On the back row, put a pumpkin at each end and a fence post in the middle.

layers.name: Body
layers.tip: A hay bale on top of the post.

layers.name: Arms
layers.tip: Another hay bale, with two fences on each side for arms.

layers.name: Head
layers.tip: Use shears on a pumpkin to carve a face. Put it on top, facing the front.

layers.name: Hat
layers.tip: A dark oak slab makes a hat.

builds.name: Sheep pen
builds.about: A fenced field for sheep, with a gate and a little shelter in the corner.

layers.name: Shelter floor
layers.tip: Find a flat grassy spot. Swap the grass in the back left corner for oak planks. Leave the rest as grass: sheep eat it, and it grows back.

layers.name: Fence
layers.tip: Put a fence all the way around, with a gate in the middle of the front. One more fence post holds up the shelter roof.

layers.name: Shelter roof and lights
layers.tip: Oak slabs over the corner make the shelter. Torches on the other corners help stop monsters appearing inside. Hold wheat and sheep will follow you in.

builds.name: Snowman
builds.about: A big snowman with a red scarf, an orange nose and a black hat.

layers.name: Bottom
layers.tip: Snow blocks in this round shape. Dig snow with a shovel to get snowballs: 4 snowballs make a snow block.

layers.name: Top of the bottom
layers.tip: A smaller square on top.

layers.name: Middle and arms
layers.tip: Another square, with a black wool button at the front and a fence on each side for arms.

layers.name: Scarf
layers.tip: A square of red wool.

layers.name: Nose
layers.tip: Snow again, with orange wool sticking out at the front for the nose.

layers.name: Eyes
layers.tip: Snow, with two black wool eyes at the front.

layers.name: Top of the head
layers.tip: One more square of snow.

layers.name: Hat
layers.tip: A square of black wool.

layers.name: Top of the hat
layers.tip: One more black wool in the middle. Want a snowman that moves? Stack two snow blocks with a carved pumpkin on top to make a snow golem.

builds.name: Star statue
builds.about: A bright yellow star standing on a stone base.

layers.name: Base
layers.tip: A line of stone bricks, 5 long and 3 deep.

layers.name: Feet
layers.tip: Two yellow wool, near each end of the base.

layers.name: Legs
layers.tip: Two wool on each leg, coming in towards the middle.

layers.name: Middle
layers.tip: Three wool in the middle join the legs.

layers.name: Body
layers.tip: Five wool.

layers.name: Arms
layers.tip: Seven wool, all the way across.

layers.name: Top point
layers.tip: One wool in the middle.

layers.name: Tip
layers.tip: One more on top makes the point.

builds.name: Starter hut
builds.about: A quick little hut for your first night, with a bed and a crafting table inside.

layers.name: Walls, bed and table
layers.tip: On flat ground, put a log in each corner and planks between them. Leave the middle of the front open for a door. Put the bed along the back wall and the crafting table beside it.

layers.name: Windows and light
layers.tip: Glass on each side makes two windows. A torch on the crafting table lights it up.

layers.name: Top of the walls
layers.tip: One more row all the way around. This time the front closes over the door.

layers.name: Roof
layers.tip: Cover the top with oak slabs. Put a door in the gap and close it at night.

builds.name: Swing
builds.about: A wooden swing on two posts, with a seat hanging from fences.

layers.name: Gravel
layers.tip: On flat grass, swap a square of grass in the middle for gravel, 3 by 3.

layers.name: Posts
layers.tip: Put a log at each end, with one square of grass between each log and the gravel.

layers.name: Seat
layers.tip: Two more logs on the posts. The seat is three oak slabs hanging from the ropes, so leave it for the very end.

layers.name: Ropes
layers.tip: Two more logs on the posts. The fences here are ropes that hang from the beam, so add them at the end too.

layers.name: Tops of the posts
layers.tip: One more log on each post. Two more rope fences, also for the end.

layers.name: Beam
layers.tip: Join the posts with spruce planks across the top. Now hang the ropes: two fences down from the beam on each side. Then put the slab seat under them.

builds.name: Vegetable garden
builds.about: Rows of wheat, carrots, potatoes and beetroot around a square of water, with a fence to keep animals out.

layers.name: Water and farmland
layers.tip: On flat grass, dig one block in the middle and fill it with water. Use a hoe on the grass around it to make farmland, 5 by 5. Leave a ring of grass around the edge.

layers.name: Plant and fence
layers.tip: Plant a row of each crop: wheat seeds, carrots, potatoes, beetroot seeds, then wheat again. Put a fence on the grass all around, with a gate at the front.

layers.name: Lights
layers.tip: A torch on each corner post helps the crops grow at night.

builds.name: Well
builds.about: An old stone well with a wooden roof, like the ones in villages.

layers.name: Water
layers.tip: A ring of cobblestone with water inside.

layers.name: Wall
layers.tip: Another ring on top, with a log in each corner.

layers.name: Posts
layers.tip: Just the four corner logs, going up.

layers.name: Posts
layers.tip: One more log on each corner.

layers.name: Roof
layers.tip: Cover the top with spruce planks.

layers.name: Roof top
layers.tip: A smaller square in the middle.

builds.name: Cozy cottage
builds.about: A little house with a stone base, a pointy roof and a chimney that puffs smoke.

layers.name: Stone base
layers.tip: A ring of cobblestone, 9 by 7, with oak planks inside for the floor. Leave a row empty in front and behind for the roof to hang over.

layers.name: Walls and door
layers.tip: Logs in the corners, planks between, and a gap in the middle of the front for the door. Bricks in the back corner start the chimney. Put a crafting table, a furnace and a barrel inside.

layers.name: Windows
layers.tip: Glass makes six windows: two at the back, two at the front and one on each side.

layers.name: Top of the walls
layers.tip: Close the wall all the way around, over the door too.

layers.name: Roof edge
layers.tip: Spruce stairs along the front and back, one block out from the walls, with their tall side towards the middle. Planks fill the two ends.

layers.name: Roof
layers.tip: The next line of stairs, one step in and one up.

layers.name: Roof
layers.tip: One more step in. The chimney keeps going up through the roof.

layers.name: Roof
layers.tip: The last line of stairs on each side.

layers.name: Roof top
layers.tip: Spruce slabs along the top. A campfire on the chimney makes smoke.

builds.name: Fountain
builds.about: A stone fountain with a pool around it and a little bowl of water on top.

layers.name: Pool
layers.tip: A square of stone bricks with one in the middle. Fill the inside with water.

layers.name: Edge and middle
layers.tip: Slabs all around the edge. In the middle, stone bricks in a plus shape.

layers.name: Top bowl
layers.tip: A small ring of stone bricks on top, with water in the middle.

builds.name: Greenhouse
builds.about: A glass house full of flowers, little trees, pumpkins and melons.

layers.name: Base and beds
layers.tip: A frame of oak planks with logs in the corners. Inside, two beds of dirt with a gravel path down the middle.

layers.name: Glass walls and plants
layers.tip: Glass walls with a door at the front. Plant flowers and saplings in the dirt, with a pumpkin and a melon in the corners.

layers.name: Glass walls
layers.tip: More glass, with logs in the corners. The door stays open.

layers.name: Glass roof
layers.tip: Cover the top with glass, logs in the corners.

layers.name: Roof
layers.tip: A smaller roof on top, three rows deep.

layers.name: Roof top
layers.tip: One row of glass along the top.

builds.name: Horse stable
builds.about: Two stalls for horses, with hay to eat, water to drink and gates to keep them in.

layers.name: Stalls
layers.tip: Walls at the back, the ends and in the middle. Hay and a cauldron of water in each stall. Fences with a gate across the front.

layers.name: Walls
layers.tip: More wall, with a window at each end. Another hay bale on top of the first.

layers.name: Walls
layers.tip: One more row of wall and the front posts.

layers.name: Roof
layers.tip: Stairs along the back and the front, sticking out one block over the gates. Oak planks fill the middle.

layers.name: Roof
layers.tip: One step in on each side.

layers.name: Roof top
layers.tip: Spruce slabs along the top.

builds.name: Mushroom house
builds.about: A house shaped like a giant mushroom, with a red spotty roof.

layers.name: Floor
layers.tip: A ring of white terracotta, 5 by 5, with oak planks inside.

layers.name: Walls and door
layers.tip: Leave the middle of the front open for the door. A torch inside keeps it bright.

layers.name: Windows
layers.tip: Glass on the left and right walls.

layers.name: Top of the stem
layers.tip: Close the ring all the way around.

layers.name: Cap
layers.tip: The cap is wider than the stem: red wool 7 by 7, without the corners. A few white wool spots.

layers.name: Cap
layers.tip: A smaller square on top, 5 by 5.

layers.name: Cap top
layers.tip: A small square of 3 by 3 finishes the cap.

builds.name: Pond with a bridge
builds.about: A little pond with sugar cane at the edges and a wooden bridge to walk across.

layers.name: Dig the pond
layers.tip: On flat grass, dig a hole one block deep in this shape. Fill it with water from a bucket.

layers.name: Bridge
layers.tip: Build the bridge across the middle, three blocks wide, with stairs going up at each end. Plant sugar cane by the water and flowers on the grass.

layers.name: Railings
layers.tip: Fences along both sides of the bridge, and more sugar cane on top of the first.

builds.name: Castle tower
builds.about: A tall stone tower with a ladder inside and a lookout on top.

layers.name: Floor
layers.tip: A ring of stone bricks, 9 by 9, with cobblestone inside.

layers.name: Walls and door
layers.tip: Walls with a gap in the middle of the front for the door. Put a ladder on the inside of the back wall, near the left.

layers.name: Walls and door
layers.tip: Again: the door is two blocks tall. Keep the ladder going.

layers.name: Walls
layers.tip: Close the wall all the way around.

layers.name: Windows
layers.tip: Glass in the middle of every side.

layers.name: Walls
layers.tip: One more full ring.

layers.name: Top floor
layers.tip: Spruce planks over the inside, with a hole for the ladder and one more ladder in it.

layers.name: Battlements
layers.tip: Every other block around the edge, like teeth.

builds.name: Lighthouse
builds.about: A tall striped tower with a ladder inside and a light at the top to guide boats home.

layers.name: Base
layers.tip: A round base of stone bricks, 7 by 7 without the corners.

layers.name: Tower 1 of 10
layers.tip: A ring of white concrete, with a gap at the front for the door. Put a ladder inside on the back wall.

layers.name: Tower 2 of 10
layers.tip: Keep building the ring and the ladder.

layers.name: Tower 3 of 10
layers.tip: Now red: every two rows the colour changes. Keep the ladder going up.

layers.name: Tower 4 of 10
layers.tip: Keep building the ring and the ladder.

layers.name: Tower 5 of 10
layers.tip: White again, with a little window on the right.

layers.name: Tower 6 of 10
layers.tip: Keep building the ring and the ladder.

layers.name: Tower 7 of 10
layers.tip: Keep building the ring and the ladder.

layers.name: Tower 8 of 10
layers.tip: Keep building the ring and the ladder.

layers.name: Tower 9 of 10
layers.tip: Keep building the ring and the ladder.

layers.name: Tower 10 of 10
layers.tip: Keep building the ring and the ladder.

layers.name: Balcony
layers.tip: A floor of stone bricks over the whole top, 7 by 7. Leave the hole for the ladder, with one more ladder in it.

layers.name: Railing and light
layers.tip: A fence all around the edge. In the middle, a jack o'lantern for the light, with a fence post at each corner of it.

layers.name: Posts
layers.tip: One more fence on each of the four posts.

layers.name: Roof
layers.tip: A red roof, 3 by 3, on the posts.

layers.name: Roof top
layers.tip: One red block on top.

builds.name: Small pirate ship
builds.about: A wooden ship with a cabin, a tall mast, a big sail and a lookout at the top.

layers.name: Bottom
layers.tip: Build it on the beach or in the water. Start with a strip of dark oak planks, 9 long and 3 wide.

layers.name: Deck
layers.tip: A wider layer makes the deck: 11 long and 7 wide, with a little more at each end and a point at the front.

layers.name: Sides, cabin and mast
layers.tip: Spruce planks around the edge of the deck. At the back, the cabin walls with a door facing the front. An oak log in the middle starts the mast.

layers.name: Railing and cabin
layers.tip: Fences on top of the sides. More cabin wall: the door is two blocks tall.

layers.name: Cabin windows
layers.tip: Close the cabin wall over the door, with glass windows at the back.

layers.name: Cabin roof and sail
layers.tip: Spruce slabs over the cabin. The sail starts: white wool across the ship, right in front of the mast.

layers.name: Sail
layers.tip: Keep going up: mast and sail.

layers.name: Red stripe
layers.tip: A red stripe across the middle of the sail.

layers.name: Sail
layers.tip: White again.

layers.name: Top of the sail
layers.tip: The last row of the sail.

layers.name: Yard
layers.tip: Fences along the top of the sail hold it up.

layers.name: Lookout
layers.tip: A ring of spruce slabs around the mast makes the lookout.

layers.name: Lookout railing
layers.tip: Fences around the lookout, and the mast goes one higher.

layers.name: Flag
layers.tip: A red flag at the very top: one wool on the mast and one beside it.

builds.name: Treehouse
builds.about: A hut high up a tree, with a ladder, a porch with a railing and leaves all around the top.

layers.name: Trunk
layers.tip: Start the trunk with one oak log. Put a ladder on its front.

layers.name: Trunk
layers.tip: Another log and another ladder on top.

layers.name: Trunk
layers.tip: Keep going up.

layers.name: Trunk
layers.tip: One more log and ladder.

layers.name: Platform
layers.tip: Build a floor of oak planks, 7 by 7, around the trunk. Leave the hole where the ladder goes up, and put one more ladder in it.

layers.name: Railing and hut
layers.tip: A fence all around the edge. One step in, the hut walls: logs in the corners, spruce planks between, and a door at the front.

layers.name: Windows
layers.tip: More wall, with glass on the back and both sides. The door stays open.

layers.name: Roof
layers.tip: Spruce slabs over the whole platform, around the trunk.

layers.name: Leaves
layers.tip: Leaves all around the top of the trunk. Collect them with shears.

layers.name: Leaves
layers.tip: A smaller square of leaves.

layers.name: Leaves
layers.tip: A little plus shape on the very top.

builds.name: Windmill
builds.about: A stone and wood tower with four big white sails on the front.

layers.name: Stone base
layers.tip: A ring of cobblestone, 5 by 5, with a gap at the front for the door.

layers.name: Stone base
layers.tip: Again, with the door gap.

layers.name: Stone base
layers.tip: One more ring, closed over the door.

layers.name: Wood and lower sail
layers.tip: Now oak planks with logs in the corners. In front of the door, start the lower sail: a fence with white wool to its left.

layers.name: Windows
layers.tip: Windows on both sides. The lower sail keeps going up.

layers.name: Right sail
layers.tip: The lower sail gets one more. The right sail starts with white wool beside it.

layers.name: Middle of the sails
layers.tip: An oak log in the middle of the front holds the sails. Fences go out to the left and right.

layers.name: Roof and upper sail
layers.tip: Cover the top with planks, with stairs all around the edge, tall side in, and planks in the corners. The upper sail is a fence with white wool to its right, and the left sail is wool on top of its fences.

layers.name: Roof
layers.tip: A smaller ring of stairs. The upper sail keeps going.

layers.name: Roof top
layers.tip: One plank on top. The upper sail gets its last fence and wool.

builds.name: Bed with a nightstand
builds.about: A bed with a little table beside it, a light on top and a rug at the end.

layers.name: Bed and nightstand
layers.tip: Put the bed against a wall, with its pillow at the back. A barrel beside it is the nightstand, and carpet in front makes a rug.

layers.name: Light
layers.tip: A torch on top of the barrel.

builds.name: Bookshelf wall
builds.about: A wall of bookshelves with a reading rug in front.

layers.name: Bookshelves
layers.tip: A log at each end with three bookshelves between. Carpet in front makes a reading rug.

layers.name: Bookshelves
layers.tip: The same again on top.

layers.name: Bookshelves
layers.tip: One more row.

layers.name: Top
layers.tip: Oak planks across the top.

builds.name: Couch
builds.about: A comfy couch with arms, a rug and a little table in front.

layers.name: Couch, rug and table
layers.tip: Three stairs in a row with their tall back against the wall make the seat. Planks on each end are the arms. Carpet for the rug, and slabs high up for the little table.

builds.name: A garden with no paths
builds.about: A fenced garden with flowers and a pond, but no way through.

layers.name: Grass and a pond
layers.tip: Start on flat grass. Dig a hole two blocks by two at the back and fill it with water.

layers.name: Fence and flowers
layers.tip: Fence all the way round, with a gate in the front. Plant flowers in the corners.

yourTurn.say: Now add paths, so you can walk round without stepping on the flowers.
ideas: A dirt path. Use a shovel on the grass. Builder tricks has more.
Stepping stones of gravel or stone slabs.
A little bridge over the pond, made of slabs.
A bench to sit on, made of stairs.

builds.name: An empty room
builds.about: A room with a floor, walls and windows, and nothing inside yet.

layers.name: Floor
layers.tip: A floor of planks, 7 by 6.

layers.name: Bottom of the walls
layers.tip: Walls round the edge of the floor, with logs at the corners and a gap for a door.

layers.name: Windows
layers.tip: Glass for windows at the back and on the sides.

layers.name: Top of the walls
layers.tip: A full ring of birch planks, right over the door too.

yourTurn.say: Now fill it with things. What kind of room will it be?
ideas: A bedroom: a bed, a lamp and a rug made of carpet.
A kitchen: a smoker, barrels and a table.
A library: bookshelves on every wall.
Room ideas in Builds has lots more.

builds.name: A house with no roof
builds.about: Four walls with windows and a door. The roof is up to you.

layers.name: Stone bottom
layers.tip: A ring of cobblestone with logs at the corners. Leave a gap in the front for the door.

layers.name: Windows
layers.tip: Planks, with glass for the windows. Keep the door gap open.

layers.name: Top of the walls
layers.tip: A full ring of planks, right over the door too.

yourTurn.say: Now give it a roof. Any roof you like!
ideas: Stairs that step up to the middle. Builder tricks shows you how.
A flat roof with a fence round it, for a roof garden.
A glass roof, so you can see the stars.
A roof of wool in your favourite colours.

builds.name: A tower with no top
builds.about: A stone tower with a ladder inside. How will you top it off?

layers.name: Bottom
layers.tip: Stone bricks, with a gap in the front for a door. The ladder goes on the inside of the back wall.

layers.name: Side windows
layers.tip: Glass on both sides. Keep the door gap and the ladder going.

layers.name: Over the door
layers.tip: Close the wall over the door.

layers.name: Front window
layers.tip: A window in the front and the back.

layers.name: Top of the walls
layers.tip: One more ring of stone bricks. The ladder reaches the top.

yourTurn.say: Now top it off. Make it yours!
ideas: Castle tops: blocks with gaps between them, all round the edge.
A pointy roof made of stairs.
A lookout with fences round the edge and a lantern.
A flag made of wool on a fence post.

builds.name: Fireplace
builds.about: A brick fireplace with a campfire inside, a shelf on top and a chimney.

layers.name: Hearth
layers.tip: A row of bricks against the wall. In front, a brick on each side of a campfire.

layers.name: Over the fire
layers.tip: More bricks, and three across the front over the fire.

layers.name: Shelf
layers.tip: Three bricks at the back, and slabs in front make a shelf.

layers.name: Chimney
layers.tip: A brick in the middle starts the chimney, with a torch on each side.

layers.name: Chimney
layers.tip: Keep the chimney going up to the ceiling.

builds.name: Fish tank
builds.about: A glass tank with sand at the bottom. Add fish with a bucket of fish.

layers.name: Stand
layers.tip: A stand of oak planks, 5 by 3.

layers.name: Sand
layers.tip: Glass around the edge, sand inside.

layers.name: Water
layers.tip: More glass, with water inside.

layers.name: Water
layers.tip: One more row. Then use a bucket of fish on the water.

builds.name: Kitchen
builds.about: A row of kitchen blocks: cupboards, a smoker for cooking, a sink and a crafting table.

layers.name: Counter
layers.tip: Put them in a row against a wall: barrels for cupboards at each end, a smoker, a cauldron for the sink, a crafting table and a furnace.

layers.name: Lights
layers.tip: A torch on each barrel.

builds.name: Pet bed
builds.about: A little basket with a soft cushion for a cat or a dog.

layers.name: Basket
layers.tip: A ring of spruce slabs with a red carpet in the middle for the cushion.

builds.name: Table and chairs
builds.about: A table for two with four chairs around it, for dinner with friends.

layers.name: Table and chairs
layers.tip: Two slabs placed high in their space make the table: aim at the top half of a block. Stairs make the chairs, with their tall back away from the table.
